import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react' import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext' import { Link } from 'react-router-dom' import { Trophy, Calendar, TrendingUp, Users, Clock, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react' import { getTodaysMatches, formatMatch, COMPETITIONS } from '../services/footballApi' export default function Home() { const { profile } = useAuth() const [matches, setMatches] = useState([]) const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true) useEffect(() => { loadMatches() }, []) const loadMatches = async () => { setLoading(true) try { const data = await getTodaysMatches(COMPETITIONS.PREMIER_LEAGUE) const formatted = data.map(m => formatMatch(m)) setMatches(formatted.slice(0, 5)) } catch (error) { console.error('Error loading matches:', error) } finally { setLoading(false) } } return (
{/* 1. Welcome Banner */}

👋 Welcome back, {profile?.full_name || 'Predictor'}!

Predict matches, earn points, and climb the leaderboard

View Matches Leaderboard
⚽
{/* 2. Quick Stats */}
Points
{profile?.points || 0}
Predictions
{profile?.predictions_count || 0}
Accuracy
{profile?.accuracy || 0}%
Communities
0
{/* 3. Today's Matches */}

Today's Matches

View all
{loading ? (
Loading matches...
) : matches.length === 0 ? (

No matches scheduled for today

) : (
{matches.map(match => (
{match.homeTeam?.name} vs {match.awayTeam?.name}
{new Date(match.kickoff).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
))}
)}
{/* 4. Quick Actions */}
📋
Bet Slip
🏛️
Communities
📰
Feed
🏆
Leaderboard
) }
